storylines.title: The Berlin-Phoenix Photo Finish
storylines.summary: Berlin KAOS actually posted the better regular-season record in Season 1, but Phoenix Hurrah held the #1 seed and the title on tiebreakers. Berlin fans still bring it up to this day.

storylines.title: Ephrisy's Two-Time MVP Run
storylines.summary: Ephrisy won League MVP in Season 2 and again in Season 5 — three whole years apart — and finished with the highest Legacy Score of anyone in league history. Quiet, lethal, and let the stats do the talking.

storylines.title: The Super Burger Curse
storylines.summary: Every season, whoever posts the league's single worst Overall rating gets branded with the 'Super Burger' — a purple planet-burger badge nobody wants. It's all in good fun, but nobody's ever fully lived it down.

storylines.title: Hype's Five-Season All-Star Streak
storylines.summary: Hype made an All-Star team in every single season the league has played — the only player with that distinction. Five different rosters, five different years, one constant.
